text:
maria (product): Quick sync — we need a compact per-invocation "unit line" in the cost dashboard that shows: model SKU, token count, cache credit applied, routing surcharge, and effective unit cost. Goal is to make regressions visible during rollouts. thoughts?

alex (eng-platform): +1. can we keep it collapsible? lots of rows otherwise. maybe default to sampled 1% and expand to full for specific tenants. :+1:

ben (data): sampling tradeoffs — if we sample requests we lose precision on small but expensive chains. leaning toward deterministic sampling keyed by tenant + route so spikes are reproducible.

claudia (design): UI note — show a sparkline for unit cost over last 24h next to each invocation row. hover reveals breakdown: tokens | cache credits | routing. mockup incoming.

maria (product): @alex deterministic sampling makes sense. also need a flag to include prefetch/prefill credits in the breakdown. some customers prefill a lot and we currently drop that in summaries.

alex (eng-platform): implementation sketch: extend per-invocation telemetry with fields: `model_sku`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `cache_credit_tokens`, `routing_tier`, `surcharge_cents`, `quantization_slot`. bundle into existing `invocation_event` to avoid schema explosion. example payload:

```
{
  "invocation_id": "inv_...",
  "tenant_id": "t_123",
  "model_sku": "gptx-8q",
  "tokens_in": 120,
  "tokens_out": 450,
  "cache_credit_tokens": 200,
  "routing_tier": "dedicated",
  "surcharge_cents": 2
}
```

ben (data): that works. downstream note — we need a mapping job to attribute cache savings back to route and then to tenant. current prefetch credits are stored in a separate table, so join will be heavy. propose a nightly denormalized table plus an on-demand streaming join for recent window.

zach (sre): query perf will be important. if UI defaults to 1% sample we can precompute aggregates into hourly shards. full-tenant drilldowns should hit a dedicated fast path (materialized views) and require a permission check.

claudia (design): UX question — how do we surface uncertainty from sampling? users should see an error bar or "±" for sampled rows. also color-code rows when an invocation is impacted by a routing fallback (so cost variance is expected).

maria (product): requirement: the rollout UX must let PMs toggle "show sampled vs full" and capture a snapshot for A/B canary reviews. snapshot should store the sampling seed + time window.

alex (eng-platform): API change: add query params to cost API: `sample_seed`, `sample_rate`, `include_prefetch=true|false`, `expand_invocation_ids=[...]`. Backwards compatible defaults.

ben (data): also add `cache_source` to the event so we can separate local KV prefix cache vs shared prefetch credits. data model: `cache_source: [kv_cache|prefetch|kv+prefetch]`

infra-bot: Deploy started: feature/compound-invocation-telemetry -> staging (sha: af34b2c).

maria (product): thanks infra-bot. who owns annotation copy for uncertainty? @claudia or shall product draft?

claudia (design): I can draft. will push a small glossary: "cache credit = tokens deducted from bill because KV/prefetch returned content" and "routing surcharge = extra cents for dedicated/priority lanes".

alex (eng-platform): Implementation checklist:
- extend invocation_event proto (or json schema)
- add streaming pipeline update for cache attribution
- denormalized daily table for fast UI queries
- API params for sampling + expand
- UI sparkline + error bar + fallback highlight
- rollout snapshotting support

ben (data): I'll prototype denorm table schema. rough columns: date_hour, tenant_id, route, invocations_sampled, tokens_total, cache_credited_tokens, surcharge_cents_total, sample_seed.

zach (sre): also add an alert: if computed effective unit cost changes >30% for a tenant during a canary window, auto-pause rollout. Might be heavy but useful.

maria (product): love that. add as optional per-rollout guard.

alex (eng-platform): question: we currently bill at token granularity. do we want to show costs in cents/token or cents/invocation? probably both.

claudia (design): both, but make cents/token primary. show invocation total on hover.

ben (data): one more concern: join cardinality when attributing cache credits for chained model calls. We'll need to propagate `parent_invocation_id` so we can reconstruct chains for accurate attribution.

maria (product): add to schema. good catch.

alex (eng-platform): noted. will gate chain reconstruction behind a feature flag due to storage.

infra-bot: Deploy succeeded: staging (sha: af34b2c).

maria (product): next steps: @alex & @ben to sync on schema + data infra tomorrow 10am, @claudia will drop mockups by EOD, I'll write the rollout guard ticket. thanks all. :rocket:
